mary_acme: Hey team — our mobile client keeps dropping the SSE stream mid-response when switching from Wi‑Fi → cellular. We see a partial chunk and then the connection closes with no error. Happened multiple times today while demoing.

mary_acme: Repro steps: iPhone 13, iOS 16.5, Redwood SDK v0.9.2. Start streaming generate, wait ~2s into response, toggle Wi‑Fi off. Client log shows 'EventSource failed: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET'. Server logs show 200 then connection closed ~4s later.

sam_support: Thanks Mary — can you paste the request headers (redact token) and a minimal client log? Also which transport (SSE vs websocket) and whether you're using our hosted endpoint or Dedicated?

mary_acme: Hosted endpoint. Headers and snippet below (token redacted):
```
GET /v1/streams/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer •••
Accept: text/event-stream
Connection: keep-alive
Cache-Control: no-cache
User-Agent: RedwoodSDK/0.9.2 (iOS)
```
Client log: 
```
[14:33:12] EventSource.open -> readyState 1
[14:33:17] Received:event chunk (partial text)
[14:33:18] network: WWAN toggle detected
[14:33:18] EventSource.onerror -> readyState 0 (no further events)
```

eli_oncall: Quick checks — do you see FIN/RST from client on the server side? If not, the client or OS might be closing sockets aggressively during handoff. Also confirm token TTL vs perceived stall time. :thinking:

zoe_net: Common on mobile: NAT pinhole/idle timeouts and OS handoff can drop sockets. SSE benefits from periodic comment-heartbeats to keep NAT alive. Can you try emitting a `:heartbeat` comment every 10s and see if that reduces drops? Also try SDK v0.9.4 — we shipped a keepalive tweak that helps on iOS.

sam_support: Workaround plan: 1) ask customer to upgrade SDK to v0.9.4, 2) temporarily enable app-level heartbeats (server-side event comments), 3) if resume is needed implement last_event_id handling and re-open stream to replay from the last confirmed token/chunk. We can't truly resume in-flight SSE without app-level offsets.

mary_acme: OK will try heartbeat + upgrade and report back. If it still fails, I'll collect a pcap and the server request_id. Thanks. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Created ticket REDW-1234 and assigned to eng-sre.

eli_oncall: Assigning to zoe_net for network proxies/LB timeout review. I'll also check edge logs for abrupt resets around the provided timestamps.

zoe_net: I'll inspect LB idle_timeout and proxy reset flags (some infra defaults are 30s). If we see aggressive timeouts we can add a keepalive probe. Expect update by EOD. :eyes:

sam_support: Thanks — update thread when you have results. If customer can repro reliably we'll do packet capture and escalate to runtime infra.
